item.title: Monitoring notes with Grafana, Loki and Promtail
item.description: Throughout my professional life it is common to see many types of implementations regarding development and infrastructure; in short, when it comes to infrastructure it is common that there is no service monitoring on an organization's servers, this is more common on on-premise servers, and for this reason I asked myself a few questions.
